goal.en: Manage email templates for personal projects, send notifications through webhooks, and inspect sending records.
goal.zh: 为个人项目集中管理邮件模板，通过 Webhook 发送通知并查询发送记录。

role.en: API runtime and static asset hosting
role.zh: API 运行时与静态资源托管
管理 API 与 Webhook 路由

role.en: Projects, templates, logs and sending state
role.zh: 项目、模板、日志与发送状态存储
通过 API 发送邮件

role.en: Email sending through the Worker binding
role.zh: 通过 Worker 绑定发送邮件
依赖、脚本与 HTTP 测试

passed: four documents: relative links, images and README section order
bilingual bash parity, shell syntax and script references
fresh and repeated schema initialization in memory SQLite
explicit env-file precedence verified in installed Wrangler source
website verified from custom domain and release workflow; MIT license verified
frozen dependency install and normal Husky prepare
test environment placeholders, local URL and free ports verified without printing secrets
normal pre-commit typecheck, staged lint, Gitleaks, route/page maps and unit coverage
normal pre-push local HTTP API E2E and OSV scan
GitHub CI and Worker deployment success
limitations: Default bun dev connects to production D1; local initialization requires --env test.
Dry-run switches apply only to the legacy Resend environment path, not selected providers.
Template test sends bypass webhook recipient rules, quotas, cooldown and send logs.
HTTP and browser tests share the checkout's local test D1 database.
Provider success does not establish inbox delivery; Access and real email delivery were not exercised.

deployment.scope: Cloudflare Worker and static assets through GitHub CD
